claims.quote: Betta miniopinna is a small bubble-nesting labyrinth fish endemic to Bintan Island, Indonesia, where it is known from a few northern localities.
Betta miniopinna was described in 1994 from the remaining primary peat swamp forest on Bintan Island in the Riau Islands, Indonesia.
